item.title: State of AI Data Labs and Human Feedback · research-2026-11-12.1
item.description: This comprehensive synthesis covers the selected approved corpus of 73 qualifying supplier groups, 225 distinct reviewed paper works, 85 dataset families and 87 benchmark families. Twelve chapters connect disclosed offerings and delivery roles, technical methods, human operations, commercial units, rights and security with ten original proposed buyer pilots and explicit acceptance conditions. The bounded eligible core contains 416 source-qualified identities, with 389 deeply dispositioned (93.5096%); 102 named Unknown targets and unresolved discovery and family-identity capacities remain retained. The accepted finite 200-hypothesis reference audit and the separate screening requirement are distinct quality gates. Publication and archival status are reported separately from source and review dates. Separate AI review is not human peer review; this report claims neither a market census nor independently measured provider performance.
